title: Cleo: A Transparent and Controllable Chatbot for Conversational Commerce
title_zh: Cleo：面向会话式商务的透明且可控聊天机器人
abstract_en: We demonstrate Cleo, a transparent and controllable conversational product advisor that addresses the challenges of opacity, unpredictability of LLMs, and the complexity of comparisons in conversational commerce. With our chatbot system, we make four contributions: First, we introduce transparency by prompting the LLM to reflect on interpreted user needs, while an auditable ranking mechanism reveals loss values per attribute, explaining ranking decisions. Second, we propose controllability through a hybrid architecture separating deterministic ranking from language generation. A ranker applies categorical filters and numeric loss functions over 3,638 product specifications. Meanwhile, a constrained LLM generates grounded descriptions constrained to catalog evidence, thus mitigating the risk of hallucinated or persuasive content. Third, we provide decision support in the form of natural-language comparisons and a highlights feature. These aim to reduce mental workload by contextualizing specifications relative to user needs. Fourth, we contribute an extensible experimental system for IR and HCI researchers, as well as practitioners of conversational search and recommendation. Unlike traditional faceted search or opaque LLM-only recommenders, our approach allows for fluid conversation while maintaining algorithmic transparency. In a live demonstration, attendees will experience information needs elicitation and reflection, conversational refinement with real-time re-ranking, inspection of per-attribute loss explanations, and AI-generated multi-item comparisons. The system aims to advance the design of transparent and controllable conversational systems that provide support for decision-making during online product search.
abstract_zh: 本文展示了 Cleo，一个透明、可控的会话式产品顾问，旨在解决会话式商务中 LLM 不透明、行为不可预测以及产品比较复杂等问题。系统通过让 LLM 反思其对用户需求的理解来提升透明性，并使用可审计的排序机制展示各属性的损失值，从而解释推荐排序。Cleo 采用混合架构，将确定性排序与语言生成分离：ranker 基于 3,638 条产品规格执行类别过滤和数值损失函数计算；受约束的 LLM 则仅基于商品目录证据生成描述，以降低幻觉和过度劝服风险。系统还提供自然语言多商品比较和 highlights 功能，帮助用户将产品规格与自身需求关联起来，降低决策负担。该工作为 IR、HCI 研究者以及会话式搜索和推荐实践者提供了一个可扩展的实验系统，在保持流畅对话体验的同时实现算法透明性。
key_points_zh: Cleo 通过需求反思和逐属性 loss 展示，让用户理解系统如何解释需求以及为何给出某个排序。
系统采用混合架构：确定性 ranker 负责过滤与排序，LLM 仅负责基于目录证据生成受约束的自然语言说明。
ranker 在 3,638 条产品规格上应用 categorical filters 和 numeric loss functions，实现可审计、可复现的推荐逻辑。
自然语言比较与 highlights 功能帮助用户理解多个商品之间的差异，并将规格信息映射到个人需求。
该系统面向 conversational commerce，区别于传统 faceted search 和纯 LLM recommender，兼顾对话流畅性、可控性与透明度。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong conversational-commerce system that directly addresses transparent, controllable product search, ranking, and comparison.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高度契合对话式电商的工作，直接改进了透明、可控的商品搜索、排序与比较。
